title: Steady Refill Record on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions
content:
A steady refill record on an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription adds days to the planned supply days of its shipments when the package count is re-set under Tailwise Autoship.

**Rule.** Four or more scheduled shipments of the subscription charged in the last twelve months add 42 days; two or three such shipments add 35 days; fewer than two add no days. Ship-now shipments never count toward the record.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Record and days added

| Scheduled shipments of this subscription charged in the last twelve months | Days added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 42 |
| 2 or 3 | 35 |
| 0 or 1 | none |

## Counting cases (hypothetical, worked out on a given day)

- Three scheduled shipments and two ship-now shipments charged in the last twelve months: the record counts 3, so 35 days are added.
- Four scheduled shipments, one of them charged exactly twelve months before the day the value is worked out: that one does not count, the record is 3, and 35 days are added.
- Four scheduled shipments, all later than that day twelve months back: 42 days are added.
- One scheduled shipment: no days are added.
